## Project overview

The thesis addresses the need for a **functional, continuous and non-destructive measurement**
of liver viability during ex vivo perfusion.

The project is organized into three consecutive objectives:

1. Build and validate a stable ex vivo liver perfusion platform.
2. Characterize a physiological baseline without ICG.
3. Develop a functional marker using ICG-NIR kinetics.

<div class="image-slot large">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO GENERAL DEL PROYECTO DE TESIS
    <small>Vista completa de la plataforma de perfusión con hígado, bomba, sensores, oxigenador y computador de adquisición</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Need and hypothesis

**Need:** obtain a continuous, functional and non-destructive measurement of liver viability
during ex vivo perfusion.

**Hypothesis:** ICG uptake and hepatobiliary excretion kinetics measured using NIR fluorescence
contain parameters capable of discriminating liver functional state.

```{mermaid}
flowchart TD
    N["Need"] --> H["Hypothesis"]
    H --> O1["Objective 1<br/>Stable perfusion platform"]
    O1 --> O2["Objective 2<br/>Baseline without ICG"]
    O2 --> O3["Objective 3<br/>ICG-NIR marker"]
    O3 --> F["Functional viability assessment"]
```

## Objective 1 — Ex Vivo Perfusion Platform

### Objective

Implement an ex vivo perfusion platform capable of maintaining rat livers under controlled
and physiologically stable conditions.

<div class="image-slot large">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO DE LA PLATAFORMA DE PERFUSIÓN COMPLETA
    <small>Fotografía limpia del sistema armado, idealmente con etiquetas o una segunda versión anotada</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Perfusion circuit

The perfusion circuit is organized as:

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["Reservoir"] --> B["Peristaltic Pump"]
    B --> C["Pulse Damper"]
    C --> D["Flow Sensor"]
    D --> E["Oxygenator"]
    E --> F["Bubble Trap"]
    F --> G["Liver"]
    G --> H["Outlet / Return"]
```

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    DIAGRAMA REAL DEL CIRCUITO DE PERFUSIÓN
    <small>Esquema con mangueras, diámetros, dirección de flujo y ubicación de sensores</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Reservoir and pumping

The reservoir and peristaltic pump establish the perfusate flow through the system.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO DEL RESERVORIO Y BOMBA PERISTÁLTICA
    <small>Mostrar conexiones de entrada/salida y cabezal utilizado</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Pulse damping

Peristaltic pumping generates pressure pulsations. A pulse-damping stage is used to reduce
the amplitude of these oscillations before the perfusate reaches the organ.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO / CORTE DEL DAMPER DE PULSACIONES
    <small>Idealmente incluir una imagen del componente y un pequeño esquema de funcionamiento</small>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    GRÁFICO ANTES Y DESPUÉS DEL DAMPER
    <small>Comparación de presión o flujo mostrando la reducción de pulsaciones</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Oxygenation and bubble management

The circuit includes oxygenation and bubble-removal stages to maintain appropriate perfusate
conditions and reduce the risk of air entering the liver.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO DEL OXIGENADOR Y ATRAPABURBUJAS
    <small>Fotografía donde se vea cómo ambos componentes están integrados al circuito</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Physiological monitoring

The platform monitors:

- **P(t):** portal / pre-liver pressure.
- **Q(t):** portal perfusion flow.
- **T(t):** perfusate / organ temperature.
- **R(t)=P/Q:** vascular resistance.
- **pH / gases:** perfusate chemistry according to protocol.

<div class="image-slot large">
  <div class="slot-label">
    CAPTURA DEL MONITOR HIDRODINÁMICO
    <small>Pantalla mostrando presión, flujo, temperatura y resistencia vascular en tiempo real</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Sensors and electronics

The monitoring system combines physiological sensors, acquisition electronics, an embedded
system and software for visualization and storage.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO DE LOS SENSORES Y ELECTRÓNICA DE ADQUISICIÓN
    <small>Presión, flujo, temperatura, ESP32/Arduino, placas y conexiones principales</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Calibration and validation

Measurements are compared with reference instrumentation and characterized using quantitative
error metrics such as correlation, deviation and RMSE.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO DEL SETUP DE CALIBRACIÓN
    <small>Monitor desarrollado conectado al patrón o instrumento de referencia</small>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    GRÁFICO DE CALIBRACIÓN / ERROR
    <small>Valor medido vs referencia, correlación, RMSE o desviación</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Objective 1 success criterion

A reproducible experimental window in which the liver remains perfused, thermally stable
and its hemodynamic variables are monitored.

## Objective 2 — Baseline Dataset without ICG

### Objective

Characterize the stability of the preparation and construct a physiological reference dataset
before adding ICG.

The purpose is to distinguish expected platform and preparation behavior from effects that may
later be associated with the fluorophore or with changes in liver function.

<div class="image-slot large">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO DE UN EXPERIMENTO BASAL SIN ICG
    <small>Hígado perfundido durante una corrida utilizada para construir la línea base</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Recorded variables

The baseline dataset contains:

- Q(t) — portal flow.
- P(t) — portal pressure.
- T(t) — temperature.
- R(t)=P/Q — vascular resistance.
- pH / gases — perfusate state.

### Representative traces

<div class="image-slot large">
  <div class="slot-label">
    GRÁFICO BASAL DE PRESIÓN, FLUJO Y TEMPERATURA
    <small>Tres o cuatro curvas alineadas temporalmente durante un experimento estable</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Vascular resistance

Vascular resistance provides a derived parameter for interpreting the relationship between
pressure and flow throughout the experiment.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    GRÁFICO DE RESISTENCIA VASCULAR R(t)=P/Q
    <small>Mostrar su evolución temporal y el rango considerado estable</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Reproducibility

The baseline stage is used to estimate expected variability between experiments and determine
whether the platform provides a sufficiently reproducible experimental window.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    COMPARACIÓN ENTRE EXPERIMENTOS BASALES

## Objective 3 — ICG-NIR Functional Marker

### Objective

Develop a quantitative functional marker of liver viability from the temporal kinetics of ICG
fluorescence.

<div class="image-slot large">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO DEL MONTAJE EXPERIMENTAL ICG-NIR
    <small>Hígado, fuente NIR, filtros, cámara/sensor y geometría completa del ensayo</small>
  </div>
</div>

### ICG experiment

ICG is introduced into perfusate containing albumin. The liver uptake and excretion process is
observed using near-infrared fluorescence acquisition.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
    A["ICG + albumin"] --> B["Liver uptake"]
    B --> C["NIR fluorescence"]
    C --> D["FI(t)"]
    D --> E["Kinetic parameters"]
```

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    DIAGRAMA ÓPTICO DEL SISTEMA ICG-NIR
    <small>Fuente de excitación → hígado → filtro de emisión → adquisición NIR</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Optical calibration

Before interpreting fluorescence physiologically, the system should characterize the relation
between ICG concentration and measured fluorescence under controlled conditions.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    FOTO DEL ENSAYO DE CALIBRACIÓN ICG + ALBÚMINA
    <small>Viales o recipiente de calibración con geometría de adquisición fija</small>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    CURVA CONCENTRACIÓN DE ICG VS INTENSIDAD DE FLUORESCENCIA
    <small>Mostrar rango lineal, saturación y región útil de trabajo</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Fluorescence kinetics

The target signal is the temporal fluorescence curve, FI(t), or a calibrated estimate of
C_ICG(t).

<div class="image-slot large">
  <div class="slot-label">
    CURVA REPRESENTATIVA FI(t) DE ICG
    <small>Señal temporal completa mostrando captación, peak y eliminación</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Functional parameters

Parameters to derive from the curve include:

- ICG-PDR — disappearance rate.
- ICG-R15 — retention at 15 minutes.
- ICG-CLR — clearance.
- Fmax.
- Tmax.
- Uptake / washout slopes.
- AUC.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    CURVA ICG CON PARÁMETROS MARCADOS
    <small>Indicar gráficamente dónde se obtienen PDR, R15, clearance, Fmax, Tmax, slopes y AUC</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Functional viability index

The final objective is to investigate whether ICG-derived parameters can be compared or combined
with physiological and injury-related variables to describe liver functional state.

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
    DIAGRAMA DEL ÍNDICE DE VIABILIDAD
    <small>ICG + presión + flujo + resistencia + química → parámetros → índice funcional</small>
  </div>
</div>

### Validation

<div class="image-slot">
  <div class="slot-label">
